stops.note: named the divine life force believed to animate gods, ancestors, and even spoken words
stops.meaning: spiritual power or life force; also an affirmation like "amen"

stops.note: creolized in Brazil as enslaved Yoruba people carried the concept into Candomblé practice
spread into English through Santería, Candomblé, and diaspora spiritual writing as an affirming exclamation

current_meaning: a Yoruba-derived concept of divine life force, used in English as a spiritual affirmation similar to "amen"
